content:
Maya (Product): Heads-up: FinReg wants an "Audit Evidence" flow in the console. Requirements: per-tenant cost by route + downloadable redacted trace samples for a date range. Need to scope an MVP we can pilot in Q2.
Ibrahim (SRE): Ops constraints: retention and export egress are main cost drivers. Recommend hot store 7d, archive 90d. Default sample 1%, tenant override.
Tara (Eng): Technical MVP: no per-token lineage. Instead estimate token_count from input length+model config and compute estimated cost per request. Deterministic stable sampling for traces (seed = tenant+day).
Nadia (Security): Redaction must be provable. Plan: run redaction before storage, log redaction events as pattern IDs + counts (no raw values). Bundle a redaction report with every export. Exports signed with KMS key.
Ravi (Customer Success): I'll confirm FinReg's preferred export schema (CSV vs Parquet) and acceptable sampling tolerance. Also check if they need signed attestations.
Sam (Solutions): UI concept: small tile "Audit Cost & Evidence" with sparkline + modal showing "Sampled Traces" table and Export button (CSV/Parquet). Keep filters minimal (tenant + date).
Maya (Product): Proposed MVP cuts: 1) Aggregated per-route cost (7d/30d), 2) Deterministic sampled traces with pre-storage redaction, 3) Console tile + export, 4) Tenant opt-in pilot (1 customer). Launch criteria: pilot exportable, redaction report present, perf validated.
Tara (Eng): Implementation sketch: ingress hook tags route_id+tenant_id -> estimate token_count -> hash-based sampler -> async pipeline -> redaction service -> short-term DB -> export job to S3. Pseudoconfig: 
```
audit_sampling:
  mode: stable
  default_rate: 0.01
  hot_days: 7
  archive_days: 90
  redaction_patterns: [email, ssn, cc]
```
Ibrahim (SRE): Pipeline must be async; add backpressure metrics and a drop policy when consumer lag >30s. SLO: pipeline should not add >5ms p99 when async. Also will produce cost forecast for retention.
Nadia (Security): Exports HMAC-signed; rotate keys quarterly. Add CI redaction tests and a weekly verification job that re-scan stored samples and produces a compliance report.
Maya (Product): Action items: 1) Ravi get FinReg schema + acceptance (due Thu EOD), 2) Tara draft design doc + risks (due next Tue), 3) Sam share UI mock (due next Wed), 4) Nadia outline security checklist (due next Wed), 5) Ibrahim propose retention/cost numbers (due next Wed). I'll schedule a 30m sync after docs.
deploy-bot: Flag created: feature/audit-evidence-pilot :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): If everything looks good in the design review, we aim for a Q2 single-tenant pilot. Success metrics: exported trace sample + redaction report, console tile renders <200ms, and no >2% increase in request p99. Thanks team.
